notes: Splash arm of the Qwen3.6 repair-turn workload. Derived from splash-qwen36.json; every field not named here is unchanged.

Repair-turn workload (ADR-063 Q4-QWEN36, operator decision 2026-11-03; Splash design decision D9): the client runs --repair-turns 1 (qwen38_n1_verdict.Workflow). After a failed run_tests the agent gets exactly one repair cycle: one more write_file src/ports.rs, then run_tests on the same target; the six steps then resume. A second failed run_tests fails the agent. Prompts, tools, templates, sampling, budgets and every other step are canonical, and the approval binds repair_turns 1. Qwen3.6 only (q5_case.REPAIR_FAMILIES; the client admits engine kind splash only with family_controls q3_family qwen36, coding_family.repair_allowed), on the hf2q-converted GGUF (MODEL_SHA256 815a22ca...), identical on hf2q, the peer and Splash.

Splash peer of record (ADR-063 'Splash peer of record for the Qwen families'; operator decisions 2026-11-03/11-04; design docs/research/adr063-splash-peer-design.md): incoai/splash 031a25a6 (git describe 1.5.0-29-g031a25a6), built from a clean detached clone at SPLASH_DIR with `make -j4` and `make install-environment` (build_id src-f7663ee7...). It serves the SAME hf2q GGUF as the hf2q qwen36 arm (MODEL and MODEL_SHA256 must equal that arm's; q3_identity same_model and native_peer_splash_ready.launch_problems refuse anything else) with its family's pinned DFlash2 draft. In Q3 it is the measured arm 'splash' (--splash-case), never --peer-case and never a native comparison. Adapter: scripts/four_agent/native_peer_splash.py; launch, identity, readiness and closing: native_peer_splash_ready.py; post-run audit: native_peer_splash_audit.py.

Launch (serve.argv runs native_peer_splash_launch.py, which execs in the same process, so SERVER_PID is the server): it verifies SPLASH_DIR is a clean detached 031a25a6 checkout whose build/engine/build-identity.json build_id is SPLASH_BUILD_ID, build/splash, build/splash.metallib and build/host-step.metallib have SPLASH_BIN_SHA256, SPLASH_METALLIB_SHA256 and SPLASH_HOST_STEP_SHA256 (the host-step library present: awake host steps), the host toolchain (xcodebuild -version, metal and clang++ --version, the SDK version, sw_vers) hashes to SPLASH_TOOLCHAIN_SHA256 (`splash_sweep.py identity` prints every value) and .venv carries every install/requirements.txt pin (freeze sha256 SPLASH_VENV_FREEZE_SHA256); DRAFT_DIR is the pinned HF cache snapshot; then prepares {OUT}/splash/models with Splash's install.local.prepare_local_model (no network), requires its model.json to record the GGUF content digest equal to MODEL_SHA256 and the pinned draft blob, writes {OUT}/splash/launch.json and execs `.venv/bin/python -P -u -m server.server <assembly> --model MODEL_ID --binary build/splash --host 127.0.0.1 --port PORT --max-context 256K --idle-release off --no-webui --thinking-end-text '\nI need to answer now.</think>' <SPLASH_CONFIG flags>` with PYTHONPATH=SPLASH_DIR.

SPLASH_CONFIG is the configuration (knob=value for kv, state, ane, verify, decode_share, cache_disk, max_memory, in that order; native_peer_splash.KNOBS). The default is the one-factor sweep's S0, Splash's documented defaults with decode share 0.5 explicit. The best valid configuration is chosen by scripts/four_agent/splash_sweep.py (design section 7) and recorded before the campaign of record; --max-memory stays auto unless the Q5 floor trips (decision D6). Speculation is always on (DFlash2; no off switch). Lossy defaults (int8 KV, bf16 state, the Neural Engine W8A8 FFN split) are valid unless Splash's quality gate fails (D10).

Requests (closed envelope; Splash ignores unknown fields): greedy (temperature 0, top_p 1, top_k 0, min_p 0, zero presence/frequency), thinking on with preserve_thinking, no reasoning_effort, hf2q's 2048/512 thinking ceilings as thinking_token_budget, parallel_tool_calls false (Splash's tool grammar, decision D5) and NO repetition penalty (decision D3; hf2q's 1.05 over a 64-token window has no Splash equivalent, recorded in every readiness record). Every turn's prompt is re-rendered at closing by /apply-template and counted by /tokenize (outside the makespan).

Qwen3.6 35B-A3B MoE: verify rows follow the knob (auto: the verify budget, whose greedy outputs vary run to run; all: every row); the MoE target never splits to the Neural Engine (ane must be auto). Routed experts must all load (readiness requires /status streamed_experts null). Draft incoai/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-DFlash2@51ef7b69 (config sha256 86d2e8e5..., weights LFS sha256 d1f16c0f...). Workload (operator decision D9): the Q4-QWEN36 repair-turn workload, one repair turn, as qwen36-repair1.json and peer-qwen36-repair1.json run it.

Prefix cache: Splash's exact-prefix KV/state cache is always on (RAM, plus the SSD tier unless cache_disk=0, whose files are unlinked temporaries under TMPDIR); --persistent-cache stays off. Run as a calibration (no --admission-receipt): different binary from every hf2q calibration.
